sentences: Blackstone's shares moved 5% or more on 14 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 5 November 2026, when the stock fell 4.6%.
The stock is down 22.5% this year, and at $119.50 it sits 26.9% below its 52-week closing high of $163.50 from 16 January 2026.
$1,000 invested in Blackstone five years ago would be worth $838 today.
